items_all.title: ZT135292/Dog_blood_transcriptomic_aging_clock: This repository contains code to construct canine blood transcriptomic aging clocks using gene expression profiles and age labels. Six machine learning approaches are implemented—Elastic Net, LASSO, Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression, and a mixture-of-experts model—and their predictive performance on age is compared and evaluated.
items_all.title_zh: ZT135292/DOG_BLOOD_TRANSCRIPTOMIC_AGING_CLOCK ：此存储库包含使用基因表达谱和年龄标签构建犬血液转录组衰老时钟的代码。实施了六种机器学习方法--弹性网络、套索、随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量回归和专家混合模型--并对其对年龄的预测性能进行了比较和评估。
items_all.title_en: ZT135292/Dog_blood_transcriptomic_aging_clock: This repository contains code to construct canine blood transcriptomic aging clocks using gene expression profiles and age labels. Six machine learning approaches are implemented—Elastic Net, LASSO, Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression, and a mixture-of-experts model—and their predictive performance on age is compared and evaluated.

items_all.title: shayanmostafaei/Omics_ADRD_Integrated_Modeling: This project combines multi-omics biological aging clocks, polygenic risk scores (PRS), and advanced machine learning techniques to predict Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) using UK Biobank data. It includes R and Python code for data preprocessing, model construction, survival and competing risk analysis, and visualization.
items_all.title_zh: shayanmostafaei/Omics_ADRD_Integrated_Modeling ：该项目结合了多组学生物老化时钟、多基因风险评分（ PRS ）和先进的机器学习技术，使用英国生物库数据预测阿尔茨海默病和相关痴呆症（ ADRD ）。它包括用于数据预处理、模型构建、生存和竞争风险分析以及可视化的R和Python代码。
items_all.title_en: shayanmostafaei/Omics_ADRD_Integrated_Modeling: This project combines multi-omics biological aging clocks, polygenic risk scores (PRS), and advanced machine learning techniques to predict Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) using UK Biobank data. It includes R and Python code for data preprocessing, model construction, survival and competing risk analysis, and visualization.
